# Backend Developer (Python)

**Tidevand Software GmbH** · Berlin, Germany (fully remote within the EU) · 2 positions

Tidevand builds booking software for ferry and harbour operators in eight countries. We are
a remote team of twenty, and we are hiring two backend developers.

## What you will do

- Build and maintain our booking and payments APIs.
- Design database schemas and keep queries fast.
- Review code and help shape our architecture.

## What we are looking for

- At least 2 years of backend development.
- Strong Python.
- Experience with FastAPI or a similar web framework.
- PostgreSQL, including schema design.
- Docker for local development and deployment.
- You must be allowed to work in the EU.

## Nice to have

- Some TypeScript, for our admin frontend.
- Kubernetes.

We offer fully remote work, a home office budget and two team weeks a year by the sea.
